references.label: Battlefield
references.description: The paddle-controlled upper playfield occupies the upper-left corner.

references.label: Battlefield target
references.description: Then hit the moving lit Battlefield target for the 100-million Super Jackpot.

references.label: drop target
references.description: Shoot the upper-left drop target to open the Battlefield, then shoot the lane behind it.

references.label: Left orbit
references.description: The orbit entrance is on the far left, beside the left ramp.

references.label: left ramp
references.description: Before plunging, press the left blue button to choose points or a random award at the left ramp.

references.label: right orbit
references.description: Make the left orbit, left ramp, Battlefield, Sanctum, right ramp, Start Scene, right orbit, and upper loop while their arrows flash.

references.label: right ramp
references.description: During Khan Multiball, collect the left orbit, left ramp, Battlefield, right ramp, and upper loop Jackpots.

references.label: Sanctum lock
references.description: The hidden-magnet wall and lock are in the upper center, to the right of the Battlefield.

references.label: Side saucer
references.description: The side saucer is behind the left ramp and beside the upper loop.

references.label: side targets
references.description: Use the motion to reach side targets.

references.label: side targets
references.description: Use the motion to reach side targets.

references.label: Start Scene saucer
references.description: The mode-start saucer is on the upper-right side beside the right ramp.

references.label: top drop targets
references.description: Use the paddle to make 30 yellow-target hits, then send the ball through the top drop targets to defeat Khan.

references.label: Upper loop
references.description: The upper-flipper loop is behind the left ramp, near the center-left of the upper playfield.

references.label: upper-left drop target
references.description: Shoot the upper-left drop target to open the Battlefield, then shoot the lane behind it.
